coaching.headline: Kira and Lt. Belica scored twenty-six of thirty allied kills, and a won Primal Fangtooth fight came right before the enemy Core fell.

flags.text: Kira's 54677 hero damage led all ten players, a damn clinic, plus eight of Mourn's ten deaths.
Mid was The Fey's on paper, yet Lt. Belica scored four of The Fey's five deaths.
Kira, Khaimera and Lt. Belica won three to one, then Orb Prime went enemy across the map.
Phase died to Zarus, then a shit fight a body down went one to three; Fangtooth went enemy.

focus.title: Group before every pit
focus.action: Before Fangtooth or Primal Fangtooth, Kira, Khaimera and Phase reach the pit together; with an ally dead, ward the pit and take a tower instead of fighting a body down.

15.4.call: Two separate plays: a Kira double kill on the duo lane came before Kira razed the enemy duo outer, while Aurora, Khaimera, Kwang and Zarus fell on the far side. Turn every duo-lane pick into the tower straight away.

28.7.call: Kira, Khaimera and Phase fell with no kill back before the enemy Primal Fangtooth; the enemy offlane inner still fell to the allies. With three allies down, concede the pit and take structures.

37.7.call: Primal Fangtooth went allied and the pit fight went four to one, two kills apiece for Kira and Lt. Belica, before the enemy Core fell. Take every late pit with all five allies.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: 11.4 CS per minute against a 7.5 norm, with only two deaths all game. Hold that farm pace, and whenever Mourn dies, hit the nearest duo tower.
A rotation kill on Kwang on the offlane preceded the enemy mid inhibitor falling. With Drongo and Mourn dead, repeat the trip to the next open lane.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Hero damage per minute 1091 against a 738 norm, plus the enemy mid outer razed. When The Fey shows on mid, open with the Seismic Assault stun before Neural Disruptor.
Five kills off the mid lane, three before the enemy mid outer fell, starting with Drongo before the first Fangtooth. Keep roaming whenever The Fey is dead or seen elsewhere.
Five deaths on a 3.4 norm; a death to The Fey in the allied jungle preceded The Fey razing the allied mid outer. With The Fey unseen, hold mid.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: 40404 objective damage, the most of all ten players, with 9.8 CS per minute on a 7.2 norm. After every won fight, put that damage straight onto the nearest tower.
Two of five deaths came at the Fangtooth pit, before enemy Fangtooth and enemy Primal Fangtooth. Next pit, sweep wards if a sentry is equipped, and enter with the duo.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zero kills, the game's lowest hero damage at 14355, and four of five deaths to Kwang. When the Kwang blade lands nearby, step clear before the recall stun.
Gave Kwang first blood outside any detected fight, and a later death to Kwang preceded enemy Mini Prime and the allied offlane outer falling. Trade only with Hoarfrost ready.
Razed the enemy offlane outer and placed 14 wards. Once the enemy offlane outer is down, join the next mid fight with Cryoseism ready.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Ran the vision and sustain: 20 wards on a 10.2 norm, plus 30271 healing and 19 assists, the game's most on both counts. Keep that ward pace every game.
Six deaths on a 2.7 norm, three on mid in the allied half, including a death outside any detected fight. Cross mid only beside Kira or Lt. Belica.

matchup: Duo was Kira and Phase against Drongo and Mourn; enemy duo deaths before minute ten ran four to one.
Kira out-earned Drongo 23824 gold to 17004 and scored five of the seven Drongo deaths.
Drongo's Gag Grenade silences and Shrapnel Cannon shreds physical armor; Mourn's Abduct pulls and Beguile mesmerizes.
build: Ashbringer and Imperator are two of three winning-core items; Solaris is missing.
Tainted Rounds cuts the hit target's healing on basic attacks, blunting Contagion heals from Mourn.
Imperator, finished last, makes critical strikes hit harder; earlier fights ran without Imperator.
eternal: Vermis adds bonus physical damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Xyris, Vermis and Weald are a toss-up in the Kira carry field; Serration with Breach is the best Vermis pair.
augment: Siphoning Purge heals Kira for a share of Purge damage dealt to heroes.
Bringer Of Mercy, Lenore and Siphoning Purge are a three-way toss-up in the Kira carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets, with a recast on hero kills.
Liberator and Pacifier are a toss-up in the Kira carry field; Pacifier is the most played. Sound keep.
improvement: Breach for Melting Point matches the best Vermis pair: Purge damage shreds physical armor instead of bonus damage on high-armor targets.
Solaris over Scattershot completes the winning core: an empowered, self-healing basic attack after each ability cast, giving up the homing projectiles.

matchup: Duo read favored Kira and Phase; the lone Phase kill was Mourn on the duo lane.
Six Phase deaths came from five different enemies; Drongo was the only repeat killer.
Kwang's tether and Surge stun and the Zarus Barricade stun are the main dive threats on Phase.
build: Prophecy, Tainted Scepter, Spectra, Orion and Plasma Blade skip the whole winning core: Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves.
No magic resist against a three-magical enemy comp: the five items add no magical armor.
Enra's Blessing shields a nearby immobilized ally, a direct answer to the Kwang and Zarus stuns.
eternal: Lotus grants random stat gains over time and on takedowns; Flawless heals nearby allies on ability hits against heroes.
Support Eternals are unmodeled; Exarch is the most played Phase support Eternal, and Lotus has too few games to lead.
augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst also restore the linked ally's mana.
Psychic Support and Kindred Surge are a toss-up in the Phase support field; Psychic Support leads. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's active heals Phase and nearby heroes with brief damage mitigation; the Visionary passive raises the ward cap.
Tranquility is the most played Phase support crest and the only crest there with enough games to lead.
improvement: If deaths stay high, Immaculate for Prima Donna trades bonus hero damage for damage reduction while near full health.
Galaxy Greaves for Plasma Blade adds physical and magical armor against the magical enemy damage, giving up crit and attack speed.

matchup: Kwang was the lane opponent: 7/5/9 with 45003 hero damage, second only to Kira among all ten players.
Kwang's Surge of the Heavens knocks up and stuns only on a dash into the thrown blade; Judgement of the Heavens tethers.
Kwang's Tainted Guard cuts healing on basic attackers hitting Kwang, trimming Magnify omnivamp.
build: Magnify and Flux Matrix are two of three winning-core items; Elafrost is missing.
Spellbreaker's spell shield blocks the next ability, useful against the Kwang tether and the Fly Trap from The Fey.
Spectral Schematics, finished last, adds damage on immobilizing an enemy; earlier fights ran without Spectral Schematics.
eternal: Lotus grants random stat gains over time and on takedowns; Fragrance boosts magical and true damage on nearby heroes.
Vesh and Krix are a toss-up in the Aurora offlane field; Lotus has too few games to lead.
augment: Hypothermia makes Boreal Sweep shred both armors and slow attack speed on heroes hit.
Frozen Fury, Hypothermia and Glacial Thorns are a toss-up in the Aurora offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Tempest's active damages up to three nearby heroes over time and heals for part of the damage.
Winter's Fury leans ahead of Typhoon in the Aurora offlane crest field; Tempest ranks third.
improvement: Winter's Fury for Tempest stays on the Warlock Crest path: an expanding slow zone and a magical damage amp over the healing.
Elafrost for Spellbreaker completes the winning core: armor, health and a slowing empowered basic after each cast, giving up the spell shield.

matchup: The Fey killed Lt. Belica once and razed the allied mid outer; Lt. Belica out-earned The Fey 22350 gold to 17695.
The Fey's Fly Trap pulls and stuns, and Bramble Patch slows; Seismic Assault answers with a stun.
Zarus scored the last Lt. Belica death, on the mid lane in the enemy half.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings are the full winning core.
Caustica ignores a share of magical armor and hits harder on heroes above half health with bonus magical armor.
Amulet Of Chaos, finished last, cuts basic cooldowns on takedowns; earlier fights ran without Amulet Of Chaos.
eternal: Aion stacks mana regeneration on casts and pays gold from spell damage on heroes; Bottomless Vial rewards river buff kills.
Lotus and Vesh are a toss-up in the Lt. Belica mid field; Aion has too few games to lead.
Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus is the best Aion pair in the Lt. Belica mid field.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second.
Combat Veteran leans ahead of Pulsefire Rounds in the Lt. Belica mid augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window.
Typhoon leans first in the Lt. Belica mid crest field; Soulbearer has too few games to lead.
improvement: Typhoon for Soulbearer is the field lean: attack speed stacks and a dash on basic attacks, over the shield and lifesteal.
Typhoon starts from Warlock Crest and Soulbearer from Wizard Crest, so the swap begins at the first crest buy.

matchup: Zarus was the jungle opponent: 5/3/8, killing Khaimera twice without dying to Khaimera.
Zarus out-earned Khaimera 17999 gold to 16909 and cleared 8 wards, the most of all ten players.
Zarus's Barricade stuns and Coliseum traps a single hero; Khaimera's Cull suppresses and Invigorate cleanses debuffs.
build: Overlord is the only winning-core item built; Basilisk and Rapture are missing.
Draconum restores health on takedowns and boosts healing; Tainted Blade from Zarus cuts healing on physical hits.
Void Helm, finished last, adds magical armor and boosts all healing received; earlier fights ran without Void Helm.
eternal: Knell's Rust shreds both armors on hero hits and returns part of the shred; Peal applies maximum Rust on ultimate cast.
Lotus is clearly the best Eternal in the Khaimera jungle field; Knell has too few games to lead.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Feral Ambush and Jungle Invasion are a toss-up in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active damages nearby enemies and heals on hero hits.
Eviscerator is clearly the best Khaimera jungle crest; Judgement ranks below Iceskorn Talons.
improvement: Eviscerator for Judgement is the field-backed swap: attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage instead of the area hit and heal.
Eviscerator starts from Sharpshooter Crest, Judgement from Champion Crest, so the swap begins at the first crest buy.
Lotus for Knell is the clear field pick: random stat gains instead of the armor shred.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window
